tier_reason: Tier unchanged (C). Enricher e100 (2026-10-05) corrected two caveats: OpenCV's 8U ALGO_HINT_ACCURATE Gaussian path (GaussianBlurFixedPoint, ufixedpoint16 with fixedShift 8) quantizes weights to 8 fractional bits, so it is bit-exact to its own fixed-point definition but not more precise than libblur's Exact mode (f32 weights); and libblur has no C API (cbindgen.toml is 0 bytes, lib.rs has no FFI).

corrections.tradeoffs: Rust crate with NEON, SSE/AVX and WASM SIMD paths plus a scalar fallback; multithreading through novtb, which spawns and core-pins fresh threads on every parallel stage of every call. Default ConvolutionMode is FixedPoint (README: 1-3% error); Exact uses f32 weights with a u8 intermediate in both modes. No C API: cbindgen.toml is empty and lib.rs exports no FFI. README tables last edited 2025-05-09 (commit 0424e41), before the 2026 kernel rewrites (v0.24.0).
